title: Red Ribbon Week: Life is a Puzzle, Solve It Drug-Free
intro: Every choice you make is like a puzzle piece—building a stronger, sharper, mission-ready version of you. Staying drug-free isn't just about following orders. It's about dominating every aspect of Marine Corps Total Fitness (MCTF).

sections.heading: Marine Corps Total Fitness & Drug-Free Living
sections.markdown:
* Social Fitness: Trust and teamwork suffer when drugs enter the picture.
* Spiritual Fitness: Live by your values and stay aligned with your purpose.
* Mental Fitness: The mission demands clear thinking. Stay sharp, stay drug-free.
* Physical Fitness: Drugs impair performance, reaction time, and endurance.

sections.heading: How to Get Involved (October 23-31, 20-25)
sections.markdown:
* Gear Up. Wear red—ribbons, shirts, hats. Show you're all in.
* Talk it Out. Start conversations with your unit family about why staying drug-free matters.
* Sign the Pledge. Make it official: [Red Ribbon Pledge Activities](https://www.redribbon.org/virtual-activities)
* Share Online. Use #LiveDrugFree and tag:
* @RedRibbonWeek on Facebook/X
* @RedRibbonCampaign on Instagram

sections.heading: The Bottom Line
sections.markdown:
Staying drug-free boosts readiness, mission success, and strengthens both families and units. When you rock red, share your "why," and sign the pledge, you send a clear message:

**We're strong. We're ready. We're drug-free.**

Let's build a mission-ready Corps—one good choice at a time.

Need more info? Contact your installation's [Substance Assessment and Counseling Center](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/substance) or email [SMB_Drug_Demand_Reduction_Program@usmc.mil](mailto:SMB_Drug_Demand_Reduction_Program@usmc.mil).

Civilian personnel are also encouraged to participate in community activities and partner with their local Provost Marshal's Office to support local events such as collection points for Marines, family members, civilian employees, and retirees to anonymously and safely turn in unused, unneeded, and/or expired prescription medications for disposal.

Get the details you need in [MARADMIN 334/25.](https://www.marines.mil/News/Messages/Messages-Display/Article/4248478/23-31-october-2025-national-red-ribbon-week-and-prescription-drug-take-back-day/)
